snippet.title: Inferius | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss out on this new look at INFERIUS, a first-person horror roguelike deckbuilder from Lucid Rain Studios. Descend into the nine Dominions of the Inferno as you brave the terrors and creatures that hunt your soul, escape your torment by defeating this underworld's 9 Rulers. Inferius is coming to PC (Steam) in 2027 with an alpha demo available right now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/INFERIUS/ 
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards

Discord: https://discord.gg/j8wUUzJQ8D
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HorrorGameAward
Instagram: https://instagram.com/thehorrorgameawards
